text:
The steel wheels hum a rhythmic song.
Outside, the glass reflects my tired face.
City lights blur into streaks of gold.
A silent parade of sleeping windows passes.

Neon signs flicker like dying stars.
Shadows stretch long beneath the bridge.
The urban grid glows with amber heat.
Rain slicks the dark and empty streets.

Distance grows between the observer and observed.
Each mile pulls us further from home.
Silence fills the carriage with weight.
